terms.comment: Traupman’s word for a mailing list (p. 261): the flock of people on it, whose owner is the gregis moderātor. For the stored list of recipients that a mailing platform keeps, a plain description serves: catalogus dēstinātāriōrum (catalogus, a list of names, is post-classical in Lewis & Short; dēstinātārius is a modern word for a recipient).
The phrase of the computing glossary Vocabula computatralia: like Traupman’s, it names the group of people on the list.

phrases.english: Add this recipient to the list.

sources: Lewis & Short: grex
Lewis & Short: catalogus · Vocabula computatralia: list. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 261, 340.
